Hi Anu — great to meet you. Thanks for the template and VAT cert. Quick answers up front and attached our enrollment form and W-9: vendor_enrollment_form.pdf, redwood_w9.pdf.

PO acceptance and invoicing (Redwood standard):
- Required on PO for automatic processing: PO number, legal bill-to name, remit instructions (bank or remit email), invoice currency, and invoice line-level description or reference to contract line. Project codes are helpful but not mandatory; include VC-224 in the invoice reference and we will map it.
- Electronic acknowledgement is acceptable — our billing system treats an email acknowledgement with PO number as a valid acceptance within 5 business days. If acknowledgement is not received we will trigger a PO hold and notify procurement.
- Payment terms: Net 30 by default from invoice receipt unless you select alternate terms on the PO. We offer an early-pay program (1.5% for Net 10) via our FinOps team; Aditya can confirm.
- Payment rails: ACH/Direct deposit preferred. We also support wire and virtual card for smaller one-off payments.
- File transfer & invoice ingestion: we can pull invoices by SFTP or accept EDI 810; for the portal we prefer SFTP drops to reduce manual entry. Attached a short SFTP instruction stub.

Tax/VAT evidence:
- US vendors: W-9 required.
- EU reverse-charge: we require the customer-side VAT exemption form and the vendor's VAT registration cert; Rachel will confirm any additional fields for EU/GB.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm your preferred payment rail (ACH/wire).
2) Send a signed/acknowledged PO back to this thread or drop invoices via SFTP once vendor record is created.
3) Fill out vendor_enrollment_form.pdf and return.

Looping in Rachel (billing) and Aditya (payments) to surface any operational constraints. Happy to align on a mutual action plan to get Venclarity activated by 2027-06-18.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Vendor Operations, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Anu / Mina — a few operational clarifications from Billing: 

- PO acceptance: as Mina noted, an email acknowledgement that references the PO number and states 'accepted' is sufficient for our system. For any SLA-based crediting (if applicable) we do require the PO to reference the contract or SOW line.
- Invoice header: please include Redwood invoice-to: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Bill-to address: 900 Main St, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105. Remit to bank details are on the W-9 stub we provided.
- Multi-remit scenarios: we can accept a PO that routes different line items to different remit endpoints, but each invoice must be clear about remit for each line and include the appropriate remit instructions.
- EU VAT: if Venclarity is requesting reverse-charge, include the VAT registration number on the invoice and attach a copy of the registration. We will validate and log it during supplier setup.

Aditya — finance note: if Venclarity opts for ACH we'll need their bank routing and remittance email; if they want virtual card please confirm chargeback windows.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Billing Operations, Redwood
